note: Quote covers SAFI-4 and SAFI-128. TestLabeledPropagationUnchangedNextHopKeepsLabels pins SAFI 4 and TestLabeledVPNPropagationUnchangedNextHopKeepsLabels pins SAFI 128: next-hop-unchanged emits no op and mpReachNextHopHandler plans the MP_REACH verbatim, with the Next Hop, label entry, RD and prefix asserted byte for byte. The {single-polarity: positive} annotation holds: the RFC imposes nothing on a changed next hop. Observed-red record on mpReachNextHopHandler.
